title: Tailgate Talkin', duet the hook
body:
tailgate talkin' is about the best memories happening right there on a tailgate. some folks' glory days were on a field or a stage. this one's for the tailgate crowd.

duet this and sing it back at me. best ones get reposted.

script.visual: truck bed, phone propped, a buddy or two around
sing the call line, leave a beat, point at camera
script.line: sing your half of the hook, then point for their half

shot_list: film the 'call' half of the Tailgate Talkin' hook with a clear pause for the fan's half. leave headroom in frame for the duet
tailgate or parking lot, a friend or two in shot reads real
media_notes: The pause for the duet response is the whole trick.
notes: Caption now grounded in the song's real meaning (from Ben's bio). Duet/participation format kept.
